findings.title: 7 شهداء في غارات الاحتلال على مناطق متفرقة من قطاع غزة منذ فجر اليوم
findings.location: Wadi Gaza, central Gaza Strip; possible overlap with Netzarim corridor report
findings.affected_population_system: Health sources report three people killed, including a child; Reuters separately reports fatalities near Netzarim. Exact incident identity unresolved.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: وأفادت مصادر صحية، باستشهاد ثلاثة مواطنين بينهم طفل، في قصف لطائرات الاحتلال استهدف منطقة وادي غزة وسط القطاع.

bounded_discovery_context.discovery: Arabic WAFA latest-news index and full dated article, after OCHA OPT and WHO checks and 12 targeted searches.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: New fatality and child-victim information compared with prior injuries-only report. Reuters article has earlier initial publication time and an undated update; it supports a possible overlap, not a separately countable incident.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Do not add this count to earlier Netzarim reporting; military told Reuters it targeted militants; identities not independently verified.

findings.title: مصادر صحية: 272 إصابة بالتهاب السحايا في غزة خلال أكتوبر وتحذيرات من تفاقم التفشي الوبائي
findings.affected_population_system: Health sources report 272 meningitis cases in October 2026 versus a stated normal 30–50 monthly; 108 bacterial cases in October and 100 more since November began; 15 deaths since start of year. Laboratory genotyping unavailable. Sources cite overcrowding, damaged infrastructure, contaminated water and supply restrictions.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: مشيرة إلى تسجيل 272 إصابة خلال شهر تشرين الأول/ أكتوبر الماضي، بزيادة تتجاوز ثمانية أضعاف المعدل الشهري الطبيعي.
